label: No structure develops from a precursor that appears later than it does
statement_en: Taking the developmental stage as the level of a blueprint graph whose edges are develops_from, the Boolean check devOrderedB is true exactly when every edge goes strictly down in stage; its truth implies that every derivative is staged strictly after its precursor and that develops_from is acyclic. The fin subtree's own edges are certified by a kernel evaluation of the checker on the recorded stages (lean/Delphi/Certificates/FinDevelopment.lean).

lean.source:
theorem devOrdered_of_check (g : Graph ℕ) (h : devOrderedB g = true) :
    (∀ a b, g.Edge a b → g.level b < g.level a) ∧ g.Acyclic :=
  ⟨g.levelsDown_of_check h, g.acyclic_of_levelsDown (g.levelsDown_of_check h)⟩

constraint_details.canEliminate: a developmental sequence that puts a fin before its fin bud
